notes.title: Demo Update - Version 0.2.5.0
notes.notes:
We originally didn't plan to address this yet, but we've getting feedback that days feel too short. 

While we feel the day length provides an appropriate tension, we agree that it can feel short at times, especially as you're learning the game. we came up with a "quick and dirty" way to address this, and wanted to provide some resolution for any players (or poetntial players) that found the balance too unforgiving. 

As a first attempt to address this, we're increasing the base day length by 15 seconds. This might not sound like much, but we don't want to swing too far without further testing, and 15 additional seconds can equate to several precious tasks in many situations.

Additionally, we're adding another layer to casual mode that will increase the day length by about 20% (another 30 seconds). 
We hope this provides a "cozier" pacing that reduces some tension during the day without blowing the balance out. 

Please note, with these changes, not all day music has been fully reworked, and some songs will start about 30 seconds into the day when playing on casual.


Demo Version 0.2.5.0 Release Notes

Features
• Causal Mode now has longer days
• All day songs have been reworked to be at least 15 seconds longer.

Balance Changes
• Day length increased from 120 seconds to 135 seconds (+15s) in standard difficulty
• Day length increased from 120 seconds to 165 seconds (+45s) in "casual mode" difficulty
• Enemy count & spawn rate reduced slightly
• Enemy "spider" count & spawn rate further reduced for prologue

Fixes
• Fixed a bug that would cause the game to hang for a few seconds after the Boss appeared.

Known Issues
• Two of the four day songs will start 30 seconds late on casual mode, as music is still in process of being reworked.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix - Version 0.2.4.1
notes.notes:
This hotfix addresses two issues:

The first is a bug involving the crafting guide that would cover the feasting menu, making it virtually unusable... which sounds as annoying as some bathroom bullies, to me.

The second is that we believe the boss is a little too hard for the demo. So we're removing the boss's "defense" so it takes full damage, and increasing the overall HP for a net 23% less health.

Happy Nightmare slaying!

Demo Version 0.2.4.1 (Hotfix) Release Notes

Balance Changes
• The Chapter 1 Boss now takes 100% damage instead of 50% damage.
• The Chapter 1 Boss HP increased from 650 to 1000 (with the above change, this is about 23% less health)

Fixes & tweaks
• Fixed a bug that would draw the crafting guide on top of the feast menu if it was the last tab opened.

notes.title: Demo Update - Version 0.2.4.0
notes.notes:
This update aims at making three changes to the demo.

The first goal is to provide a "casual mode" for players who are looking for a less challenging experience. Our first attempt at this is done by reducing damage received and reducing enemy quantity by 50% each. We are very open to changing this to meet player expectations, so please provide any feedback if you are looking for a less challenging experience. 

Our second goal is to provide a more "snappy" combat experience to reduce any felt sluggishness during combat. The overall attack now takes fewer frames, has a shorter "recovery time", and a few other QoL changes that are common in modern games.

Our third and final goal was to optimize the game some to reduce the chance of slowdown on some machines. There is definitely still room for further optimization, but now static offscreen objects are culled/disabled, which showed about a 40% improvement to game speed in internal testing. If you are still experiencing slowdown, please try adjusting the video settings to remove silhouettes and simplify lighting and let us know of your results.

Demo Version 0.2.4.0 Release Notes

Features
• A "Casual Mode" difficulty option has been added, which reduces damage received by 50% and reduces enemy count by 50%. This should remove some friction for players not looking for as much challenge in the night segments. This option can be changed at any time in the gameplay settings menu.

Balance Changes
• The attack animation now has a faster windup (from about 12 frames to about 6 frames)
• The attack cooldown has been reduced from 1 second to .5 seconds (triggered at attack start)
• Attacks now trigger from input presses, and no longer repeat when holding the attack input
• Added .25s (about 15 frames) input buffering for attacks, to allow you to "queue up" attacks before the previous animaiton is finished.
• Pressing the dash input mid-attack will now cancel the recovery portion of the attack animation even if you can't dash. This will allow you to have your full movement speed back, but the attack cooldown will still be in effect.
• Increased most enemy HP slightly to compensate for faster attack speeds

Fixes & tweaks
• optimization - static offscreen objects are now disabled, resulting in ~40% faster game speed
• Improved the experimental "Auto Attack" gameplay setting to feel smarter, account for current attack range, and not trigger if either the attack or dash input is pressed. (Still not perfect, and still marked experimental)
• Fixed a bug with the transform plate that would cause it to provide some willpower when blue

notes.title: Demo Update - Version 0.2.3.0
notes.notes:
Hey Players!

In preparation for Steam NextFest, which begins on Monday, we've updated the demo to include several bug fixes, quality of life improvements, and a few new features that are in line with our vision for the full game. 

Enjoy!

Release Notes for Demo v0.2.3.0

Features
• Added several more interactions with the plush in the bedroom
• Added sound effects when getting in and out of bed
• Added a sound effect when the spider-like enemies die
• Made some minor thematic changes to how the first dream ends
• Texture pages now flush occasionally to reduce total VRAM usage

Balance Changes
• Tabs in the pause menu are now unlocked over time, rather than all being available from the beginning
• The Moon Plate now only glows orange on night 1, and fizzles out on all other nights
• Gold enemies no longer spawn in the prologue or on "nightmare" nights
• Wood now burns at a rate of 2.5 hours/stick, down from 7 hours/stick
• "Survivor" outfit max duration reduced from 12h to 10h

Fixes & Tweaks
• Fixed a bug that would prevent enemies from spawning
• Fixed a bug in the tutorial that prevented a tooltip from appearing
• Fixed a graphical glitch that would occur when interacting with the plush in your bedroom the first time
• Fixed a bug that would prevent a new journal entry from being unlocked/drawn
• Opening a cache after unlocking everything available now spawns a collection of food at your feet, as originally intended
• Improved interactable selection logic when playing with a gamepad or without a mouse
• Improved widescreen support slightly
• Updated some of the tutorial popups to include images
• New upgrades at the plush now have a silver border instead of orange
• Additional Quality of Life improvements and fixes

Known Issues
• Due to a change with the way a small portion of the game save data is stored, there's a small chance some save data could be overwritten, although the game will attempt to update any out of date data.
• Occasionally, after the boss fight begins, the game will hang for a few seconds or possibly several seconds. After waiting for some time, the game will usually resolve the hang on its own
• Certain scenarios may be un-ideal when playing in ultrawide resolutions (e.g. seeing things that are intended to be offscreen, or being able to access areas that are typically out-of-bounds)
